title: AtlasParser
summary: A PDF-to-Markdown conversion tool built with Marker for preparing documents for LLM use, created for a coding bootcamp team. The apparent SDV match is a coincidental substring inside a conda build path in requirements.txt, not an actual reference to the Synthetic Data Vault.
evidence: requirements.txt: 'more-itertools @ file:///.../abs_e2687gwsdv/...' — 'sdv' is a random substring in a local build path
needs: No real SDV usage; flagged as name collision due to substring match in a file path.
